correctness.rationale: A length-n periodic word is exactly a closed walk in the given 64-state order-three graph. Exact integer power-trace calculations and Newton identities reconstruct all 65 characteristic coefficients and match the claimed factorization. Matrix determinant logs prove the all-length zeta; Burnside and Möbius formulas give all rotation and primitive counts. Complete brute force through length seven is an independent direct model check. Operational validity is restricted to n>=4.

value.rationale: Four letters model the DNA alphabet with two Watson-Crick complement pairs; cyclic irreducible strands and their primitive rotation classes are a natural complete finite-length constrained-sequence inventory. The zeta polynomial exposes boundary-dependent and nonleading spectral information absent from open-boundary word counts. It is a nontrivial exact all-length classification, with applications as enumerative benchmarks, without claiming optimal error-correcting codes.
